```{=html}
<div class="sla-animation" data-sla-animation>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 400 400" role="img" aria-label="Stereolithography printing animation">
    <rect class="sla-frame" x="18" y="18" width="364" height="364" rx="8"></rect>
    <rect class="sla-vat-back" x="54" y="280" width="292" height="64" rx="5"></rect>
    <rect class="sla-resin" x="58" y="286" width="284" height="40" rx="2"></rect>
    <g class="sla-final"></g>
    <g class="sla-current"></g>
    <g class="sla-active"></g>
    <line class="sla-resin-surface" x1="58" y1="286" x2="342" y2="286"></line>
    <g class="sla-platform">
      <rect class="sla-platform-rod" x="-5" y="-84" width="10" height="84" rx="3"></rect>
      <rect class="sla-platform-plate" x="-86" y="0" width="172" height="14" rx="3"></rect>
    </g>
    <g class="sla-laser">
      <line class="sla-laser-beam" x1="200" y1="362" x2="200" y2="316"></line>
      <circle class="sla-laser-dot" cx="200" cy="316" r="4"></circle>
      <rect class="sla-laser-source" x="180" y="358" width="40" height="12" rx="3"></rect>
    </g>
    <path class="sla-vat-front" d="M 54 280 H 346 V 344 H 54 Z"></path>
  </svg>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const roots = document.querySelectorAll("[data-sla-animation]:not([data-sla-ready])");
  if (!roots.length) {
    return;
  }

  const svgNamespace = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const layerHeight = 14;
  const layerGap = 2;
  const layerCount = 15;
  const positionsPerLayer = 40;
  const stepMilliseconds = 1000 / positionsPerLayer;
  const visibleLayerHeight = layerHeight - layerGap;
  const platformHeight = 14;
  const activeLayerY = 310;
  const activeLayerCenterY = activeLayerY + visibleLayerHeight / 2;
  const scanMinX = 76;
  const scanMaxX = 324;
  const material = "#6b63d9";
  const activeMaterial = "#7d72f0";
  const finalMaterial = "rgba(107, 99, 217, 0.13)";
  const partWidths = [
    [136, 264],
    [136, 264],
    [132, 268],
    [130, 270],
    [128, 272],
    [126, 274],
    [122, 278],
    [118, 282],
    [84, 316],
    [84, 316],
    [96, 304],
    [110, 290],
    [126, 274],
    [144, 256],
    [164, 236],
  ];
  const layers = partWidths.slice().reverse().map(([start, end]) => ({ start, end }));

  function makeRect(parent, segment, y, fill, endX = segment.end) {
    const width = Math.max(0, Math.min(segment.end, endX) - segment.start);
    if (width <= 0) {
      return;
    }
    const rect = document.createElementNS(svgNamespace, "rect");
    rect.setAttribute("x", String(segment.start));
    rect.setAttribute("y", String(y));
    rect.setAttribute("width", String(width));
    rect.setAttribute("height", String(visibleLayerHeight));
    rect.setAttribute("rx", "2");
    rect.setAttribute("fill", fill);
    parent.appendChild(rect);
  }

  function layerY(layerIndex, currentLayer) {
    return activeLayerY - (currentLayer - layerIndex) * layerHeight;
  }

  function finalLayerY(layerIndex) {
    return activeLayerY - (layerCount - 1 - layerIndex) * layerHeight;
  }

  function platformTopY(currentLayer) {
    const platformBottomY = activeLayerY - currentLayer * layerHeight - layerGap;
    return platformBottomY - platformHeight;
  }

  function renderStatic(root) {
    const finalGroup = root.querySelector(".sla-final");
    finalGroup.textContent = "";
    layers.forEach((layer, index) => {
      makeRect(finalGroup, layer, finalLayerY(index), finalMaterial);
    });
  }

  function renderFrame(root, step) {
    const currentLayer = Math.floor(step / positionsPerLayer) % layerCount;
    const position = step % positionsPerLayer;
    const progress = position / (positionsPerLayer - 1);
    const laserX = scanMinX + (scanMaxX - scanMinX) * progress;
    const currentGroup = root.querySelector(".sla-current");
    const activeGroup = root.querySelector(".sla-active");
    const platform = root.querySelector(".sla-platform");
    const laserBeam = root.querySelector(".sla-laser-beam");
    const laserDot = root.querySelector(".sla-laser-dot");
    const activeLayer = layers[currentLayer];

    currentGroup.textContent = "";
    activeGroup.textContent = "";

    layers.forEach((layer, index) => {
      if (index >= currentLayer) {
        return;
      }
      makeRect(currentGroup, layer, layerY(index, currentLayer), material);
    });

    if (laserX > activeLayer.start) {
      makeRect(activeGroup, activeLayer, activeLayerY, activeMaterial, laserX);
    }

    platform.setAttribute("transform", `translate(200 ${platformTopY(currentLayer).toFixed(2)})`);
    laserBeam.setAttribute("x2", laserX.toFixed(2));
    laserBeam.setAttribute("y2", String(activeLayerCenterY));
    laserDot.setAttribute("cx", laserX.toFixed(2));
    laserDot.setAttribute("cy", String(activeLayerCenterY));
  }

  roots.forEach((root) => {
    root.dataset.slaReady = "true";
    renderStatic(root);
    let step = 0;
    renderFrame(root, step);
    window.setInterval(() => {
      step = (step + 1) % (layerCount * positionsPerLayer);
      renderFrame(root, step);
    }, stepMilliseconds);
  });
})();
</script>
```
